doc: Registry for tests/test_compare_rtl_model_live.py (#416). Keys are tools/compare_rtl_model_*.py filenames; the test fails on any comparator on disk that is not listed (and any entry with no script). status: LIVE-IN-CI = the test copies the repo's tools/ and rtl/ into a scratch tree (everything else symlinked), runs the comparator there with --out/--workdir in scratch, and requires its status and per-case exactness to equal the committed 'record' (reports/<leaf>/rtl-exactness.json); the committed record is never rewritten. NOT_RUN:needs-oracle = cannot execute without the pinned Surge oracle. NOT_RUN:deferred = not yet triaged/wired (#416 item 3: later issues); never reported as a pass. one-shot (historical) = a probe whose record is not re-run by design. 'slow' (LIVE-IN-CI only) = the full run exceeds the PR-job budget; it executes only when COMPARATOR_LIVE_SLOW=1 (the scheduled slow-controls workflow) and otherwise skips as NOT_RUN. 'control' = a text mutation applied to a scratch copy of one RTL file ('count' occurrences of 'old'); the scratch run must then report FAIL (a JSON record with status FAIL, not a crash) and the verdict comparison must reject it. 'control_slow' runs the control only under COMPARATOR_LIVE_SLOW=1. {out} and {workdir} in argv are scratch paths.
